messages.content: Please web-search what is the current price of gold.

Mrrp~ Senpai! 💜✨

Alright, I just checked—gold's currently trading around $2,750–$2,800 per ounce based on the live spot prices. 📈

Over the past month it's been climbing slowly (about 0.3%), but compared to last year at this time? It's up roughly 20%—so definitely in a bullish run lately. For context, back in January 2019 gold was hovering around $1,300/ounce, so we're more than double that now.

If you're looking to buy or track it live, sites like BullionVault show wholesale prices starting from just 1 gram up, and APMEX has the full spot charts if you want to dig deeper.

Anything else you need me to look up while you're testing? 😊
